invariants.rationale: The method throws if operationType is LOG_COMPACT, so on exit it must not be.
The table parameter must be non-null for the method to execute without exception.
instantTime is used without null checks, so must be non-null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is dereferenced, so must be non-null.
If the pendingCompactionTimeline contains the inflight instant, the method reloads the active timeline which implies metaClient was non-null.
